original:
Let $q\geq 2$ be a power of two and $s,k\geq 1$ . Then

 $R(K_{s,kq},\mathbb{Z}_{q})=s+kq\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad s\geq q\ \text{ or }\ q-s\in\{2^{j}:j\geq 0\}.$ 

For $q\geq 4$ , the least $s_{0}$ for which equality holds for every
 $k\geq 1$ and every $s\geq s_{0}$ is $q-2$ . For every $m\geq 2$ ,

 $R(mK_{q,q},\mathbb{Z}_{m})=2qm+\frac{m}{\gcd(m,q)}-1.$
